verdict.rationale: LangGraph's architecture (nodes as plain functions, custom tool handling not requiring LangChain tools) implies agents could be unit-tested with mocks, per community commentary, but there is no explicit documentation, testing utilities, or guide for mocking models/tools in the evidence pack. missing for 10: dedicated testing/mocking docs, official test utilities, first-party guidance on unit-testing agents with mocked LLMs/tools.
